decisions.reason: The ID Vault builds directly on the firm's existing digital identity and secure document expertise, so the firm can readily assimilate and improve it.
The identity-bound digital payment wallet combines the firm's identity and payment capabilities, making it closely related to existing knowledge and likely to be understood and enhanced.
The NFC authenticator leverages the firm's authentication and security knowledge, though it involves some hardware integration that slightly increases uncertainty.
The secure payment and wallet framework fits squarely within the firm's payments and security expertise, enabling effective learning and commercial application.
The super-app platform is the core strategic direction and builds on the firm's integrated secure ecosystem capabilities, so abandoning it is highly unlikely.
The application shielding library directly extends the firm's application-security knowledge, so the firm can interpret and refine it well.
